sloka: निवर्तस्व दशग्रीव शैले क्रीडति शङ्करः ।सुपर्णनागयक्षाणां देवगन्धर्वरक्षसाम् ।। ७.१६.१० ॥
transliteration: nivartasva daśagrīva śaile krīḍati śaṅkaraḥ ।suparṇanāgayakṣāṇāṁ devagandharvarakṣasām ।। 7.16.10 ॥

translations.english: "Turn back, O Dashagriva, for Shankara is sporting on this mountain, which is inaccessible to Suparnas, Nagas, Yakshas, Devas, Gandharvas, and Rakshasas."
